reference_adapter_scope: Pure mapping and validation, not a network client, production FE integration or recovery writer. Existing owner authorization remains authoritative.

profile.auth: Bearer access token; no query on read/update
profile.metadata: Preserve data and meta.profile_contract, meta.security_contract when supplied, meta.request_id and actual response ETag together.
profile.context: Read warehouse_context.status/error_code; do not replace null active_warehouse_id or infer warehouse selection. Profile ETag is not an authorization snapshot.
profile.precondition: Use exact strong quoted ETag from the matching canonical profile. Reject weak/missing/mismatched ETag in FE; do not fabricate an old version. Numeric If-Match remains backend compatibility, not FE fallback.
profile.result: 200: replace profile and metadata atomically with data/meta plus new ETag. 428 missing version; 412 STALE_VERSION; 422 INVALID_VERSION/PROFILE_FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE/PROFILE_EMPTY_UPDATE or validator code. Do not automatically replay writes.

logout.auth: Bearer access token required by current owner route
logout.native: Only with approved existing body transport: X-WMS-Token-Transport: body and JSON refresh_token from this same family. Missing native refresh or unapproved transport must not silently fall back to another mode.
logout.web: HttpOnly refresh cookie, browser credentials enabled and JSON {}. Never put refresh_token in browser JS/body.
logout.result: 200 success=true, data=null, meta.auth_result.state=SUCCEEDED; read scope CURRENT_AUTH_SESSION_FAMILY or CURRENT_ACCESS_TOKEN_ONLY explicitly. The scope is not inferred from local storage cleanup.
logout.scope_caveat: Server can determine a family from a valid signed sid without a presented refresh token. This does not authorize FE to replace its selected native transport contract silently.

change_password.auth: Bearer access token; no If-Match or idempotency semantics invented for this operation
change_password.policy: Read meta.security_contract.password_policy when supplied. Current P11 adds max_utf8_bytes (72 for bcrypt) and NUL rejection to 8-128 Unicode characters/confirmation; do not silently normalize or truncate passwords.
change_password.wrong_current: 422 CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT; does not end the session
change_password.result: 200 success=true/data=null plus meta.auth_result.state=SUCCEEDED, relogin_required=true and session_policy=RELOGIN_ALL_REFRESH_FAMILIES_REVOKED. Clear authentication only for the matching current caller generation; never clear a newer login from a late response.
change_password.sensitive_storage: No passwords/tokens in checkpoint, logs, test evidence or automatic retry queues. No account mutation smoke on live without explicit approved accounts/operation.

sessions.rows: Preserve data[]/meta/links; latest source also exposes session_id alias and meta.current_session_id even when current family is off-page. Never infer total from one page.
sessions.revoke: DELETE /api/v1/auth/sessions/{id}; no body fields or query. Target id is returned refresh-row UUID, NOT auth_session_id/session_id. Require is_current=false and can_revoke=true; server rechecks ownership and whole-family policy.
sessions.errors: 409 CURRENT_SESSION_PROTECTED; foreign/missing target 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Readback absence is not an operation receipt; no automatic mutation replay after UNKNOWN.
sessions.metadata: device_label/location remain null when absent. user_agent/ip_address are stored unverified headers, not proven device or geographic location. last_active_at is login/refresh time, not each API request.

pending.avatar: supported=false; no upload URL or file policy is authorized
pending.permission_groups: groups=null, BA_MAPPING_REQUIRED; no role/prefix inference for six UI groups or action grants
pending.request_reconciliation: unsupported; X-Request-ID is correlation only. GET me/sessions cannot prove an earlier mutation outcome. Do not reuse P09 receipt IDs/paths/keys or expose invented retry/status endpoints.
pending.end_shift: P14 owner dependency; logout does not end a shift, delete drafts or authorize clearing all storage
pending.deployment: Requires release SHA/ancestry/schema and approved native/browser smoke and deny evidence. Source/CI/health alone do not prove deployment.

order: Paged sessions and row-id revoke target
fe_integration.callback_guard: Invalidate caller ticket on navigation, new request, logout/new login; refresh retains stable family but FE must compare its current auth generation. Reject stale callbacks before modifying auth/store/UI.
fe_integration.unknown: Separate HTTP/domain errors from timeout/malformed response. Missing success metadata is not server-confirmed completion. No auto retry of profile/password/logout/revoke. Local sign-out is not proof of remote revocation.

evidence_policy.historical_observation: PostgreSQL log: 12 tests/162 assertions passed and cached-route check passed; workflow failed publishing artifacts due storage quota. Not a whole-workflow PASS or live acceptance.
evidence_policy.current_run: Workflow prints exact SHA, per-case redacted results and totals for both databases before retaining the existing mandatory artifact upload step. Artifact delivery failure remains a reported failure; no test/production gate is bypassed.
